reviews.x: I am 68 years old and my heels have had cracked skin for most of my life. I have tried creams and lotions for years with no luck. I ordered Savanaah's Organic Argan Oil on the advice of my son who has also had problems with his heels. After applying the oil once or twice a day for a couple of weeks, my heels look like a baby's. No cracks, just smooth skin. I am amazed! I think that it has smoothed the wrinkles on my face too.

I have used Mogador, Pur a Dor and Watts brands...all of which were nice.  Nothing wrong with them.  I won't spend more than $25 for 4 ounces so I jump brands when they are on sale...as long as they are 100% argan oil.  So, this time I tried Savanaah's.  It is really nice.  And I was surprised and very pleased that it came with both a dropper AND a pump.  I like using the pump but sometimes a recipe will call for a drop of argan oil.  You won't go wrong if you purchase this.  **UPDATE December 1

I purchased this oil after a friend told me her stylist sprayed Argan Oil in her hair and she really was pleased with the softness. I researched the oil and discovered it's many benefits. I ordered this particular product because it is pure, cold pressed and organic.... well, because I'm an organic kinda girl :) I use it on my skin as I am in my late 40's (and wish to have youthful skin). It is a most wonderful skin moisturizer, it leaves me silky soft and not greasy feeling. I am very happy. An

I use it blended with other oils for hair conditioning. It helps stop the "frizzies" on the ends of my hair. I also use it in a blend with jojoba, almond and other oils for moisturizing my face. I love the packaging, the pump bottle is so easy to use and dark color helps to preserve the oil.

reviews.t: Truly some wonderful stuff to fight "winter hands"
reviews.x: I hate winter for a lot of reasons, but one of them is that my hands get so dry that I get cracks at my fingertips. It’s annoying and painful, especially at night. I’ve tried all sorts of moisturizers without much success. The best results (if you can call it that) have been from using petroleum jelly, but that’s messy and it still doesn’t work well.  This argan oil, however, has been hugely effective. It gave me results right from the first day, and over the course of just a few days I can see

When I first got this product, I was very hesitant to try due to my acne-prone skin. I applied thin layer after washing my face. When I woke up in the morning, my face was just glowing, and my skin looked so hydrated. I swear by this product. Prior to trying this product, I read some reviews online and seemed pretty decent, but after using this product myself, I highly recommend for anyone who has a dry skin. My only complaint about this product is that it may be pricey for some people, but this

But now that I've been using it for a few weeks, I'm sold! My skin absolutely drinks up the oil and feels wonderfully soft and hydrated without being greasy. This is definitely my new go-to, especially for the winter months when my skin can use the extra moisture.  Agree with other reviewers that there's a faint smell when you first apply it, but once absorbed you can't smell it at all, and it's a non-issue. Love this stuff!

I think a great product.  Been using about 3 weeks now.  Goes on and disappears right away makes skin feel very soft.  I haven't noticed any bad or off smell.  I just purchased 2 more to give as gifts.  Will continue to use.  Can't compare to the more expensive brands (as I have not used) but this one suits me just fine.  I am 64 and always use lotions - use this first and put my spf on top.

It might seem a little greasy when you first put it on but it doesn't take very long for your skin to soak it in. I love the way my skin feels for the rest of the day, very soft and smooth even after 12 hours of work. I will be purchasing this product again!

I'm not a very trusting person, so when I saw the price of this oil, I was skeptical...but hey, why not. I trusted the other reviews and bought a bottle, and I'm so glad I did. This is first-rate argan oil, and the packaging is just as nice as everyone else has claimed. The argan oil is the best thing I've ever used on my hair. While I also really like the Macadamia Nut Oil product line, Savannah's oil and the convenient pump make this a perfect choice for a nice little oil treatment after a goo

I have used other brands of cold pressed, raw, organic Argan and have been a huge fan for a while of its benefits to my skin and hair.  I am a huge believer that what you put on your skin should be non synthetic. Your skin absorbs everything just as if you have eaten it (if you don't believe it, think of medical patches.)  I thought I would try this brand after reading about it.  I was very impressed with the packaging and care that went into providing information about the oil, being fair trade

This oil is quite moisturizing and not greasy. I use the spray nozzle--1 spray is enough to moisturize my face, neck & hands after cleansing. It takes about 1 minute for the oil to fully absorb. I have dry skin and it does a good job for me, doesn't disappear like products containing water or alcohol, and not heavy like those with mineral oil. It makes a perfect base for my powder foundation. There is no scent--I wouldn't mind a little something natural but not heavy (a touch of juniper, grapefr

I am a new user of Argan oil and Savannah's is my second brand. I love the price and packaging. I have not begun using it yet, but, am looking much forward to it as soon as I'm finished with the other brand.  After reading all the wonderful reviews for this product, I know I won't be disappointed. Ladies, this stuff works amazingly! It's natural and beats all the expensive designer brand cosmetics and skin care products out there. Who knows, maybe the secret ingredient behind the expensive lifti

Exceptionally packaged product! Glass bottle sent with pump and dropper to choose from, packaged nicely in small box within another box (great for gifting). No odor, great moisturizing benefits with no greasy feel! Softened my hands and cuticles better than anything else I have used! Deeply moisturized my face as well. I have sensitive skin and had slight pinkness on cheeks with first application, have had no skin reactions since. It's great to use a natural product when I can!

"Beautifully, safely boxed and a truly Outstanding Product. I would recommend this to anyone and plan to keep purchasing, You can look at any number of what are so-called pure Argan Oils, but this is absolutely the real, perfect, organic oil.  I live in FAR Northern Maine and this will keep my skin beautiful through the cold winter months by giving it, healthy nourishment.  Thanks for an amazing product."

I have never given a review of any product before.  I would have given this product a perfect score based on the packaging alone.  You can see that this company cares about their product as soon as you open the box.  It was packaged so well I felt like I was receiving a gift.  The price was great and the oil smells wonderful!  I will buy from this company again!

I had skin cancer on my leg and after a wide excision I was left with an ugly scar. No more thanks to this product. I also use it on my cuticles and all over as a moisturizer. Not greasy. It absorbs immediately yet stays there until I shower the next day. Will never by another moisturizer

This is an excellent and quality product and you can tell so just from the outside. Lovely packaging and presentation. Gives you a choice of pump or dropper and lid. Very convenient.  The oil itself is excellent and works great on hair, face or body.  Highly recommended!
This oil absorbs very nicely and leaves my face feeling moisturizer all day. It does have a bit of a scent when you open the bottle but there is no scent when applied.  Very nice product.
The great thing about argan oil is the way it is absorbed into your hands and skin.  I even put it in my hair at night and have no problems rinsing it out when I shampoo in the morning.
I have really enjoyed this product. I have never used anything like this before and have been quite pleased. I have sensitive skin and I haven't had any problems with my skin.
This is really a good buy. I have bought really expensive argan oil that was not as good. No funny smell. I've had it a month or so, and it still is fresh. Good quality.
I love the oil.  It gives my hair a soft sheen without feeling oily.  I rub it on the end of my hair to prevent split ends.  I would highly recommend this product.
This Argan oil is great!!! I love the way it makes my skin feel and will keep in using it! A+++ Highly recommend this seller and super fast shipping!
I have used this product for approximately 3 weeks and I am extremely happy with the results. It has made my hair softer and more manageable.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for moisturizing dry skin, including heels, hands, cuticles, and face, with many noting it absorbs well without feeling greasy.
Many reviewers highlight the nice packaging, especially the pump/dropper options and gift-ready boxing.
Several reviewers consider it good value for a pure, organic, cold-pressed argan oil at a reasonable price.
Some reviewers mention using it for hair, reporting reduced frizz and softness.
A few reviewers note initial skepticism that turned into satisfaction after use.
